title.en: One-arm pull-up

summary.en: Strict one-arm pull-up in the chosen grip. Heavy weighted pulling plus unilateral skill work from week one, criteria-gated phases, 5-week blocks (4 build weeks + 1 deload week that ends with a test day replacing session B).
summary.nl: Strikte one-arm pull-up in de gekozen grip. Zwaar gewogen trekken plus eenarmig vaardigheidswerk vanaf week één, fasen met criteria, blokken van 5 weken (4 opbouw + 1 terugschakelweek met testdag in plaats van sessie B).

provenance.evidenceNote: The 65-75 % BW threshold, the 20 s hang and 8 s top-hold gates are coach heuristics (Kavadlo, StrongFirst forum, Willoughby), not research. The machine offset of 6.5 kg is the user's estimate ('6-7 kg'). All P-tagged rules are proposals that the user approves one by one (D8).

tagLegend.A: Taken from the artifact or the Todoist task descriptions; executed as written unless the P proposal that supersedes it is approved (D8, C48). Generic load-jump caps do not limit these RULE-mode loads; a step above the generic cap raises warning WE-S2 at WARN severity and is logged (D13, C45). In-session A rules change the remaining sets immediately and can be undone (D14, C46).
tagLegend.P: Proposal by the app design; active only when the user approved it (param approved_<proposalId> = true). Decisions are stored per proposal id; one proposal may switch several rules (C48). Undecided proposals are inactive.
tagLegend.D: Fixed by docs/DECISIONS.md (user decision or canonical resolution); not a program rule from the artifact and not a proposal.
tagLegend.E: Engineering default needed to execute an A rule deterministically; does not change training content.

attemptChecklist.en: Started from a dead hang with the arm fully extended (no kip, no pre-bend)
Bar or fixed handle (no free-hanging ring)

title.en: Gate the weekly session-A pin decrease

rationale.en: An unconditional -5 lb per week is about +4.9 % one-arm load per week; gating it on completed sets and adding +5 lb after two failed weeks mirrors the program's own 90-degree-hold logic.

ifDeclined.en: The pin drops 5 lb (10 lb after a controlled calibration negative) after every session A in a normal week, as written.

title.en: Definition of a missed week

rationale.en: The program says 'missed week: no make-up, same weights' but never defines 'missed'; proposal: a session counts when at least half of its working sets were logged, and a week counts when at least 2 of the 3 required sessions count.

ifDeclined.en: A week is missed only when no challenge session at all was completed in it.

title.en: Definition of an 'easy' session C

rationale.en: Session C drops 5 lb after two easy sessions in a row but 'easy' is undefined; proposal: all 3 x 5 per arm done with at least 3 reps in reserve on every set (target is 2), or you tapped 'too easy'.

ifDeclined.en: Only an explicit 'too easy' tap on the exercise counts as easy.

title.en: Definition of 'progress' for the stall rule

rationale.en: 'Two test days without progress' needs a metric; proposal: e1RM +1.0 kg, or weaker-arm hang +2 s, or weaker-arm top hold +1 s, or weaker-arm least assistance 5 lb lower, versus the previous valid test.

ifDeclined.en: Any strict improvement in any of those four metrics counts as progress.

title.en: In-block progression for A 4 x 4 and C 4 x 5

rationale.en: Only B has an in-block rule; proposal: +2.5 kg next week when every set reached its target reps with at least 2 reps in reserve and no grip slip (same rule as B).

ifDeclined.en: A and C weighted loads stay fixed until the next test day.

title.en: One-arm dead hang target from your latest fresh hang

rationale.en: The C hang (4 x 10 s per arm) is 'reviewed on test day' without a formula; proposal: floor(0.67 x weaker-arm test-day hang), at least 10 s, at most +5 s per test, at most 30 s (15 s fresh -> 10 s, as now).

ifDeclined.en: The target stays 10 s; the test-day summary asks you whether to change it.

title.en: Block-relative test dates

rationale.en: Each block is 5 weeks counted from the test actually done (matches the Todoist 'every 5 weeks' recurrence); the artifact's fixed table would make block 2 only 4 weeks after the postponed first test (F9).

ifDeclined.en: Tests follow the fixed date list from the artifact (8 Nov, 13 Dec 2026, 17 Jan, 21 Feb, 28 Mar, 2 May 2027).

title.en: Max strict reps moved to the end of the test day

rationale.en: A set of 18+ reps drains grip before the one-arm hang and top-hold tests; testing it last protects the gate metrics (F10).

ifDeclined.en: Todoist order: 3RM, max reps, hang, top hold, least assistance.

title.en: Negatives keep their own 8 s / 5 s progression

rationale.en: With the personal curve (D7) the 105 % formula would drop negatives from 47.5 to 42.5 kg although they progress on their own rule; proposal: the test-day recalculation never lowers them if at least one valid negative session was logged in the block, and the reset level moves up 5 kg with each increase.

ifDeclined.en: On each test day negatives = 105 % of the gate e1RM (rounded down) and the reset level = that minus 2.5 kg; the reset level does not follow increases.

title.en: Test-day recalculation of the anchor and A/B loads via the personal curve

rationale.en: The program recalculates working weights on test day without a formula for the anchor; proposal: anchor = anchorFraction x new 1RM total - bodyweight (anchorFraction frozen at import, so today's 20 kg is reproduced), kg per rep = slope of your curve at the anchor, A = anchor + 1 rep, B = anchor + 3 reps, each change clamped to +/-5 kg.

ifDeclined.en: The anchor stays the last measured C load; A = anchor + 1 x 2.17 kg and B = anchor + 3 x 2.17 kg, unclamped.

title.en: Pins from the least-assistance test

rationale.en: Proposal: A pin = weaker-arm least-assist pin + 10 lb, C pin = A + 10 lb, 90-degree hold pin = A - 5 lb (reproduces today's 40 / 50 / 35 lb pattern and the original 35 + 10 = 45 lb start).

ifDeclined.en: Pins are not recalculated on test day; they continue from their weekly rules.

title.en: In-session grind rule for B

rationale.en: A B set with fewer than 2 reps or 0 reps in reserve means the load is above today's capacity; taking 2.5 kg off the remaining sets avoids failure on weighted pulls (D10). Like every in-session challenge rule it applies immediately and shows 'Rule: ... · Undo' (D14, C46).

ifDeclined.en: No automatic change; you decide.

title.en: In-session +5 lb for the A machine after a failed set

rationale.en: After the calibration set, a set where the weaker arm got 2 or more reps below target adds 5 lb assistance to the remaining sets, to stop grinding one-arm reps. It applies immediately and can be undone (D14, C46).

ifDeclined.en: Only the first-set calibration adjusts the pin during the session.

title.en: Injury exit needs 3 pain-free days

rationale.en: The elbow protocol ends after two weeks; proposal: only if the last 3 days were pain-free, otherwise extend by 7 days and advise a physiotherapist.

ifDeclined.en: The protocol ends after exactly 14 days.

title.en: Pause handling

rationale.en: After a pause of 7 days or more the current week repeats with the same loads and the test waits for a clean session; after 28 days or more the block-start loads are restored and the block restarts at week 1.

ifDeclined.en: Any pause resumes the same week with the same loads; the test waits for a clean session.

title.en: Completion with either arm

rationale.en: The challenge against your friend is 'one rep'; one valid rep with either arm completes it.

ifDeclined.en: A valid rep with each arm is required.

title.en: Three ladders in the 1-2-3 variant of B

rationale.en: The stall step switches B to ladders of 1-2-3 without a count; 3 ladders = 18 reps, close to the 6 x 2 = 12 reps plus the extra singles.

ifDeclined.en: The app asks for the number of ladders when the variant activates.

title.en: Phase 2 and 3 sessions as drafts

rationale.en: Phases 2 and 3 are only sketched; encode drafts now (machine to finger ladder, three-angle holds, typewriters if a wide bar exists, attempts first in phase 3) and refine them with you before gate 1 can realistically pass.

ifDeclined.en: After a gate pass the phase-1 sessions continue until the definition is revised.

title.en: Test-pending weeks stay deload weeks

rationale.en: When the test is postponed, the waiting week keeps the deload format (half sets, same loads) so you arrive fresh at the test.

ifDeclined.en: Waiting weeks use the full build sessions.

title.en: One-arm 5 s negative placed after least assistance on test day

rationale.en: The phase-1 gate needs the negative on a test day, so it is part of every test day (C65) although the Todoist order omits it; testing it right after least assistance keeps it away from the hang and top-hold tests and before max reps when P08 moves them to the end. Since C65 the definition fixes the test-day order, so this proposal confirms the place the template already gives it.

ifDeclined.en: The negative keeps its place in the test template (right after least assistance); the test-day wizard has no free order (C65).

title.en: Test protocols for least assistance and the 3RM

rationale.en: Least assistance: start at the A pin + 10 lb, -5 lb after each clean rep, stop at the first failure, max 5 attempts per arm, 3 min rest. 3RM: ramp 50 / 70 / 85 % of the expected 3RM total, then +2.5 kg attempts, max 3 working attempts, 4 min rest.

ifDeclined.en: The wizard only states the goal ('least assistance for one clean rep', 'heaviest clean triple').

title.en: Plank plate size

rationale.en: After 30 s the program adds 'a plate on the upper back' without a size; proposal: 5 kg.

ifDeclined.en: The app asks for the plate weight when the step is reached.

title.en: 24 h protected window after B for elbow flexors

rationale.en: B is the heaviest elbow-flexor session (weighted 6 x 2 plus 47.5 kg negatives); no curls or heavy grip work in the 24 h after it (C12 marks this window as a proposal).

ifDeclined.en: No window after B.

title.en: B returns to 6 x 2 after a test with progress

rationale.en: The ladder variant is a stall remedy; once a test shows progress again, B returns to the standard 6 x 2 progression.

ifDeclined.en: B stays on ladders until you change it.

title.en: Definition of a 'clean session'

rationale.en: The test waits for 'a normal session without complaints'; proposal: an A, B or C session with at least 80 % of its working sets logged and no pain report.

ifDeclined.en: Any completed A, B or C session without a pain report counts.

title.en: Day of the weekly fresh two-arm hang measurement

rationale.en: The daily hang task says 'measure your best time fresh once a week' without a day; proposal: Monday (or the first day of the week without a gym session).

ifDeclined.en: You pick the day each week (a 'measure today' toggle on the hang task).

title.en: What 'light bilateral' means during the elbow protocol

rationale.en: The protocol says 'no unilateral work, keep training bilaterally light'; proposal: pull-ups at bodyweight, rows and dips with at least 3 reps in reserve, half the sets, prehab doubled.

ifDeclined.en: Unilateral and eccentric items are removed; the remaining items keep their loads with a 'keep it light' note.

explain.en: Negatives logged this block keep their own progression; the recalculation may raise them but never lowers them.
Weaker arm needed {weak} lb: A {pinA} lb, C {pinC} lb, 90-degree hold {pinHold90} lb.

then.to: clamp(floor(p.hangTargetFraction * min(t.oa_hang_s)), p.hangTargetMin, min(p.hangTargetMax, s.oaHangS + p.hangTargetMaxStep))

explain.en: C hang target = 67 % of your weaker fresh hang ({weaker} s), within 10-30 s.

rules.source: proposal P06; Todoist C ('reviewed on test day')

explain.en: Your fresh one-arm hang is above 15 s on a test day: starts from a dead hang may return (needs a definition update).

rules.if: sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && !s.pinAReportShown && valid('oaa') && last(ex.oaa.pin) <= p.pinAReportLb && count(ex.oaa.reps) >= ex.oaa.plannedRows && all(ex.oaa.reps >= ex.oaa.targetReps)

explain.en: 5 x 3 per arm at 35 lb or less: the 30-08 baseline underestimated your pulling strength (noted in your history).
No clean session since the interruption: today becomes session B (deload form) and the test moves to the first Sunday after a clean session.

rules.if: sess.slot in ['A', 'B', 'C'] && mode != 'injury' && !sess.painReported && (p.approved_P25 ? sess.completionRatio >= p.cleanSessionRatio : true)

explain.en: A normal session without complaints: the next test day can go ahead.

rules.source: artifact section 01 / section 10 ('een gewone sessie zonder klachten')

explain.en: Valid test: the next block starts on Monday with the recalculated loads.
Two tests without progress: check sleep and food (not a signal to train harder). Still no progress: B switches to 1-2-3 ladders and an extra deload week is inserted.
The test showed progress again: B returns to 6 x 2.
All gate criteria met: next phase (or challenge complete).

rules.source: artifact section 03 / section 10 ('ongeacht in welke week je zit')

explain.en: New block: week 1 (or an extra deload week first).
Week closed: advance, or repeat with the same loads (no make-up), or keep waiting for the test.
Week 5 of the block: deload (half sets, same loads), test on Sunday.
This week contains a test date from the fixed list: deload, test on Sunday.
Back after an interruption: you continue in the same week with the same loads; the next test waits for a normal session without complaints.

rules.source: artifact section 10 ('Bij een gemiste week ... Na een onderbreking schuift een testdag door')

explain.en: Paused {gapDays} days: this week repeats with the same loads and the next test waits for a clean session.
Paused {gapDays} days: the block restarts at week 1 with the loads it started with.
The hand slipped before the last rep: no weight added this time (grip, not strength).

rules.source: artifact section 05 / Todoist A and B

rules.if: sess.slot == 'B' && mode == 'normal' && s.bVariant == '6x2' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.bMinRir

explain.en: All 6 x 2 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.
Negatives lasted 8 s again: +5 kg.

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: protective step back (easier); deload 'keep the weight' does not block a failure-driven reset.

explain.en: A negative under 5 s or jerky: back to {negReset} kg.

rules.if: p.approved_P09 && sess.slot == 'B' && mode == 'normal' && valid('neg') && min(ex.neg.ecc_s) >= p.negUpEccS && !any(ex.neg.jerky)

explain.en: The reset level moves up with the negatives (+5 kg).
Session A: -5 lb on the pin every week (-10 lb because the calibration negative was controlled).

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: the harder branch is guarded by mode == 'normal'; only the protective +5 lb branch can act in frozen modes.

explain.en: All 5 x 3 per arm done: -5 lb (-10 lb after a controlled negative). Missed reps: same pin; second failed week in a row: +5 lb.
90-degree hold: -5 lb every week (from the pin you finished on).

rules.source: artifact section 06 / Todoist A ('Lukt het niet, 5 lbs erbij. Elke week 5 lbs eraf.')

rules.if: sess.slot == 'A' && valid('sth') && s.sthS < p.sthTargetS && count(ex.sth.hold_s) >= 6 && all(ex.sth.hold_s >= s.sthS) && !any(ex.sth.torso_rotation)

explain.en: All six straight-arm holds clean at 6 s: next time 8 s.
Two easy C sessions in a row: -5 lb.

rules.allowInFrozenNote: E: protective step back (more assistance) is allowed in frozen modes.

explain.en: Fewer than 4 reps in a set: +5 lb assistance next time.

rules.source: Todoist C ('kom je onder de vier reps, 5 lbs erbij')

explain.en: All six plank sets clean (full time, hip did not tilt) on all three days: 20 s -> 30 s -> a plate on the upper back.

rules.if: p.approved_P05 && sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.inBlockMinRir

explain.en: All 4 x 4 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.

rules.if: p.approved_P05 && sess.slot == 'C' && mode == 'normal' && valid('wpu') && count(ex.wpu.reps) >= ex.wpu.plannedRows && all(ex.wpu.reps >= ex.wpu.targetReps) && min(ex.wpu.rir) >= p.inBlockMinRir

explain.en: All 4 x 5 with at least 2 reps in reserve: +2.5 kg next week.

rules.if: p.approved_P18 && phase >= 2 && sess.slot == 'A' && mode == 'normal' && s.pinA == 0lb && valid('oaa') && count(ex.oaa.reps) >= ex.oaa.plannedRows && all(ex.oaa.reps >= ex.oaa.targetReps)

explain.en: All sets done with {fingerLevel} fingers: one finger fewer next week.

rules.source: proposal P18 (artifact section 03 phase 2: four, three, two, one finger)

inSessionRules.source: Todoist A ('De eerste set is je ijking')
artifact section 06 / Todoist A ('Lukt het niet, 5 lbs erbij')
Todoist C ('Links eerst, rechts matcht links')

elbow_protocol.en: Stop. Elbow protocol: 14 days without unilateral work, light bilateral training, prehab doubled, daily hang dropped. Not medical advice; see a professional if it persists.

back_to_two_blocks_ago.en: The elbow protocol is over. Loads are back to the level of two blocks ago; a new block starts next Monday.

pain_persists_physio.en: Pain in the last days: the protocol is extended by a week. Consider seeing a physiotherapist.

test_recorded.en: Test recorded. New loads apply from Monday.

test_postponed.en: Test postponed: no clean session since the interruption. Today is session B (deload form).

test_still_pending.en: The test is still pending; this week stays a deload week.

missed_week_no_makeup.en: Missed week: nothing to make up. You continue where you were, with the same loads.

resume_same_week.en: Welcome back. Same week, same loads; the next test waits for a normal session without complaints.

resume_repeat.en: Welcome back. This week repeats with the same loads; the next test waits for a clean session.

resume_restart.en: Welcome back after a long break. The block restarts at week 1 with its starting loads.

grip_not_strength.en: Your hand slipped before the last rep: no weight added (grip, not strength).

grip_slip_stop.en: Hand slipped: end the set here.

stall_sleep_food.en: Two test days without progress. That is not a signal to train harder: check sleep (8 h) and protein first.

stall_ladders.en: Still no progress: B switches to 1-2-3 ladders and an extra deload week follows the test.

dead_start_unlocked.en: Starts from a dead hang can return (fresh one-arm hang above 15 s). Their prescription needs a definition update.

pin_report_baseline.en: 5 x 3 per arm at 35 lb or less: your 30-08 baseline underestimated your pulling strength.

plank_plate.en: Plank: next step is a plate on your upper back.

plank_plate_choose.en: Plank: all sets clean at 30 s. Which plate do you want on your upper back?

calibration_adjust.en: Calibration set: pin {value} for the remaining sets.

oaa_fail_up.en: Two or more reps short: +5 lb assistance for the remaining sets.

h90_fail_up.en: Hold under 6 s: +5 lb on the pin for the remaining rounds.

b_grind_down.en: That set was a grind: -2.5 kg for the remaining sets.

rotation_stop.en: Torso rotated: the set (or the clock) stops here.

hip_stop.en: Hip tilted: the set stops here.

fields.name: vars
fields.note: Any state var by name; missing vars use their init expression.

fields.name: pastTests
fields.note: Each: date, metrics, validForGate, comparable flags per metric, protocol codes, notes. C59: historical tests are imported as metric observations with validity flags only; no historical set rows are created, so RCM-1 (and the D7 gate) uses the class prior k = 30 until it has informative windows. A value recorded without an arm (the 2026-08-30 least assistance, oa_least_assist_kg 22.5) is imported for both arms.

fields.name: blockItemCounts
fields.note: Valid sessions per item key already done in the imported (current) block before cutover, for example { "neg": 4 }. Added to validInBlock() for that block only, so P09 sees the negatives done before the app took over.

fields.name: importedTestHandling
fields.note: For a test done before cutover: historyOnly when the chat workflow already recalculated the loads (import those loads as vars); recalculate to replay it as test.completed so the app's rules run.
